rules.requirement: MCC 4121 and 5411 estimated/incremental authorizations require card-not-present context.
rules.sourceQuote: Estimated and Incremental authorizations are allowed for Card Not Present

rules.requirement: MCC 5552 estimated/incremental authorizations apply to EV transactions.
rules.sourceQuote: Estimated and Incremental authorizations for EV transactions.

rules.requirement: Merchant permission must be established independently; the three listed MCC restrictions are not an exhaustive eligibility list.
Use estimated/initial authorization when the final amount is unknown. The example uses estimated indicator 1 in Acquirer Trace Data Sub Table 09 on the initial request.
rules.sourceQuote: must be used when the final amount is unknown.
rules.boundedProfile: Initial indicator 1 follows the Appendix AE example; universal placement and field representation require the applicable Appendix I layout.

rules.requirement: Incremental authorization only follows an estimated/initial authorization.
rules.sourceQuote: Only follows an estimated / initial authorization.

rules.requirement: The host identifies incremental authorization using the returned approval code in Authorization Identification Response, then supplies the incremental indicator to Visa. Do not require a merchant-created incremental indicator.
rules.sourceQuote: Host will send out the incremental indicator on behalf of the merchant to Visa.

rules.requirement: Incremental requests preserve the initial request Sequence Number.
rules.sourceQuote: Contains the same Sequence Number as the estimated or initial transaction request.

rules.requirement: Incremental requests preserve the initial Transaction Identifier; Appendix AE leaves the segment number blank.
rules.sourceQuote: Contains the same Transaction Identifier in Segment  as the estimated or initial

rules.requirement: Incremental requests preserve Terminal Transaction Number in Table ID 63, Segment 111.
rules.sourceQuote: Contains the same Terminal transaction number (Table ID 63 in Segment 111)

rules.requirement: Subsequent transactions do not resend estimated authorization indicator in Sub Table 09.
Completion sends the final amount; do not infer whether incremental amounts are deltas or accumulated amounts.

Initial and incremental approvals expire from the original initial estimate: 14 days for cruise/lodging/car or vehicle rental; seven days for other rental merchants. Incrementals do not reset that origin.
rules.sourceQuote: incremental authorization will expire seven days after the initial estimated authorization.
rules.boundedProfile: ISO LocalDate calendar-day observations; timezone, timestamp cutoff and settlement interpretation remain unresolved.

rules.requirement: For stays/rentals exceeding the window, complete the first transaction and initiate the second on or before day 14 or seven, as applicable.
rules.sourceQuote: unless they complete the first transaction and then initiate the second transaction

unresolved: Authoritative permitted-merchant eligibility and mapping from MCC to expiry category.
Transaction Identifier hosting segment is omitted in the Appendix AE sentence.
Approval-code provenance and host-created Visa incremental indicator require request/response evidence.
Acquirer Trace Data Sub Table 09 parent table, packing, and Table 63 field validation require Appendix I layout integration.
Calendar-day boundaries are a logical test profile, not a certified timezone/timestamp policy.
Chargeback and authorizer response outcomes are not generated by this training validator.
